M2 ROOT CHOOSES protected PER-NODE APPROVAL_RENEW_SAME_CONFIG, plus explicit per-Node REAPPROVE_SAME_CONFIG when ONLY prior approval time expired. Neither requires fresh proofs from unrelated cohort members; this is NOT whole-five fresh activation. Initial/cohort-mutating activation still requires all5. Immutable frozen released cohort configuration is a HISTORICAL description, not a permanent live authority; each Node has a current protected approval/release/delegation chain. Keep old signed approvals immutable and append a NEW approval with priorApprovalHash, exact Node/cohort/frozen configuration/epoch/C/R/root/image/executable/policy/floors and new bounded interval, signed by current protected operator-release authority under a separately listed approval purpose/domain. Max24h per new approval, bounded by current operator grant and cert/trust validity; no automatic time extension, unsigned in-place expiry UPDATE, approval from online use issuer or clock override. Existing legitimate operator authorization does not mean an expired/revoked approval is itself sufficient authority.
Before expiry, b_append_approval may create bounded overlap after fresh actual selected-Node+independent host measurement and current canonical DB checks. After ONLY approval expiry, READMIT/REFRESH remain denied; new protected REAPPROVE explicitly verifies same frozen configuration and fresh Node+host evidence using the independent observation lane and current valid operator grant/certs/trust. Prior business approval need not still be valid for this NEW protected approval, but any explicit revocation, containment/quarantine, mixed partial mutation, changed epoch/C/R/config/root/policy/floors or active cohort mutation fence BLOCKS this same-config lane and stays separate B-RECOVERY1/explicit reviewed mutation. Expired cert/trust cannot be repaired here. Other offline/expired Nodes remain denied individually and do not gate this Node. Do not reinterpret global expired authority as a cohort-wide all5 restart.
Then perNode new RELEASE/DELEGATION -> protected gate ARM/replace -> canonical perNode activation/current ledger -> postcommit exact key delivery/PoP -> eligibility. Define exact old/new gate drain/invalidate/CAS order and current-pointer/receipt states, so old tokens/streams do not survive switched gate. No Engine/Node/DB/key delivery atomicity claim. Loss/expiry at every step stays unavailable/UNKNOWN pending exact ledger+Node proofs; do not free claims or restore old authority. Same actual generation MAY renew approval; READMIT requires a genuinely changed trusted generation, while same-generation lease renewal is REFRESH. No C/P/R reset, floor pin or implicit new enrollment. Add explicit beforeexpiry overlap/after-only-expiry reapproval phase rows, writer/principal grants, exact current interval/nonce constraints and cases with unrelated workers offline. Approval-renewal overlap is not privilege overlap on an invalidated gate.
M1 ROOT requires actual transitive source census expansion, not a new claimed complete count. Use638109ab census-result plus exact72028 anchors. Include all callers of lock_run/lock_resources/require_execution and transitive wrappers/import/session aliases, all10 missing CP modules (including build_preparations/shards/runs/workspace_start/output_ingestion/business_handoff/shard_completion/result_view/build_execution_worker) and actual remaining module from reviewer census. Include ORM query/scalar/scalars/refresh/merge/execute/copy/with_for_update on any session alias, classify proven nonDB/nonlocking calls explicitly. Enumerate node_auth.py:108 select(Node).with_for_update, not only225. For every reachable function: actual lock tables/modes/order, outer epoch+tenant tx, helper edges and canonical B reordering/discovery+reread plan. Include proposed b_append_approval/reapprove, ARM/invalidation/ack, keydelivery, issuance, observe/reconcile writers and implicitFK/RLS assets. Static unresolved edges are explicit BLOCK/unknown, never unclassified=[] by construction. Required business/observe paths get concrete supported plans; do not globally refuse all B as a coverage fix. Add audit negatives that remove a known callsite/helper/alias/ORM lock and actually fail the census check. Actual PG lock traces remain future.
M3 ROOT chooses closed signed/typed artifacts and explicit writers for the new lanes. Gate command hierarchy MUST list ARM_EXACT_RELEASE and INVALIDATE_EXACT_GATE as protected operator-release purposes/domains, never use/safety keys. Define Node-signed gateAck with exact registered Node identity/cert, action/request/command hash, release/delegation/use-key hashes, gateId/current generation/epoch/config tuple, nonce/time/validity and durable local gate-record identity. Ack is from actual authenticated Node leaf, not a helper's asserted ARMED boolean; acknowledge only the exact durable transition. An ARM ack before CP activation confers NO business permission. Add a proposed gate-ack table and b_record_gate_ack writer with precise evidence-write EXECUTE principals (protected operator and/or narrowly authenticated verifier), no direct runtime DML and no approval permission via evidence insert.
Key delivery needs protected postcommit challenge and TWO distinct proofs. Protected delivery controller, outside ordinary runtime/use-issuer custody, reads exact committed activation ledger/Node ARMED ack/current tuple, creates unpredictable32byte single-use challenge bound to deliveryID+activationLedgerID+release/delegation/use-key public hash+Node/cohort/epoch/gate/generation+registered issuer service/TLS identity+bounded expiry. Recipient demonstrates possession by signing that exact challenge/context with the delegated use private key under fixed saintvision/node-role-key-possession/v1 domain+00+C2 bytes. This signature alone cannot approve release, invent delivery or become authority. Protected controller verifies recipient authentication/key/PoP and current committed ledger outside/reacquired canonical boundaries, consumes the challenge and records its own protected delivery-receipt signature under a separately listed key-delivery-receipt purpose/domain. Ordinary issuer cannot mint that controller receipt or write final eligible delivery rows. Bind all exact hashes and prior/current state in closed keyDeliveryReceipt, no boolean proof-of-possession. Name challenge/receipt tables or typed evidence rows, preparation/consume/final-record procedures and grants; keep b_record_key_delivery protected. No key delivery before CP commit; lost response retries SAME frozen key/challenge state through exact ledger, never regenerates silently.
ObservationScope is a CP-local typed nonbusiness result, NOT a signed bearer business grant. Define closed discriminated AVAILABLE vs AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE/other exact refusal enum, authoritative source/current or frozen-intent target DER/epoch provenance, allowed exact observation raw paths/methods, target member/intent/current tuple/challenge/expiry and diagnostic fields. b_read_observation_scope is a fixed guarded function with exact principal/scope checks, not caller-supplied SQL/identity or ChannelProof factory. Refusal cannot return an eligible scope/admission/ack; receipt reconciliation still preserves actual stop/outcome rules. Explicit schema/writer/grant/result fixtures for gateControl/safety/observeInput/signedEnvelope/roleConfig, plus full stateful symbolic chain inputs for current gate and protected delivery receipts. Cases: wrong use/safety ARM signer, absent/invalidated gate, restart-no-gate, wrong PoP/domain/key/issuer/TLS/ledger/hash/replayedchallenge/expired receipt, precommitdelivery, ObservationScope->ChannelProof/admission conversion all DENY. No actual crypto/custody proof from SYMBOLIC checks.
L1 Add all relevant k1..4 NOT-YET-CASed member revocations, not just node0. C old+1 can equal targetC with oldDER; CAS state requires exact operation ledger+DER/current full tuple, never C alone. Assert refusal rather than 'alreadydone' and retain monotonic evidence. L2 Rename LOST_RESPONSE_UNKNOWN to UNRESOLVED_AFTER_EXACT_LEDGER_REREAD and add resolved-exact-commit forward rows. Missing ledger ALONE is not proof of no external effects; follow recorded intent/Node outcome/authority gates, conflicts/unavailable/indeterminate stayQUARANTINED. An exact committed ledger does not waive freshness/revocation/new current tuple checks.
L3 CHOOSE SECURITY DEFINER lock-only procedures so ordinary runtime/online principals need NO table UPDATE/lock_sentinel privilege on authority tables. Remove constant-sentinel UPDATE, not merely reword it. Fixed qualified SQL/table scope, canonical epoch+tenant+fence order and permitted role/session identity/Node selection checks; NO arbitrary table/SQL scope or SETROLE path. Owner NOLOGIN, leastpriv owner rights, noBYPASSRLS, FORCE RLS where applicable, fixed pg_catalog search_path/qualified objects. Keep direct SELECT only where needed and distinct narrow nonce/evidence writes; key_deliveries wording uniform. Add actual future PG tests that runtime direct UPDATE/INSERT/DELETE/SETROLE fail while authorized lock procedures work.
L4 Safety body SHALL bind exact method and raw path in addition to action/Node/epoch/permit/body/nonce/expiry; action->allowed literal POST path table normative, no aliases/query/percent alternative. For context budgets CHOOSE distinct protected context-budget-approver role/key/purpose under operator planning custody, outside online runtime/use issuer/safety and not a CA/root-fence/TLS key. Its external planning trust pin authorizes only bounded measured-context budget approval (cohort/context/VMspec/resources/headroom/probe hashes/validity); add domain saintvision/context-budget/v1 to explicit hierarchy and fixtures, no actual key exists. Budget approval does not sign Node release or authorize business.
L5 Add RAW host AND guest clockOffsetMillis signed exact-int vs CP, measurement uncertaintyMillis/nonnegative, syncSource/method/producer/evidence and observedAt. Require abs(offsetMillis)+uncertaintyMillis <= min(approved skew budget,30000ms), fresh authenticated measurement tied to same context/nonce; current trusted CP time remains real, no request clock override or clock adjustment. Unknown/overbudget/untrusted source BLOCKS capability.
L6 Replace prose-derived grant regex with typed table->ALL writer procedures->EXECUTE principals/owners/columns matrix for every authority/evidence table, readonly+lock procedures separate. Remove any writer/grant or add runtime operatorgrant in a causal negative and fail; never validate just1/16 tables. Model real synthetic approval records/intervals instead of NOW+4000; make release/delegation/admission/token windows inherit those exact objects. READMIT(old,old) must reject; REFRESH handles unchanged generation.
Info: carry honest strict-int decoder dependency; define displayLabel limit in Unicode code points plus a separate explicit bounded UTF8 byte size if needed, no NFC; terminal Sequence/Nonce are protected transitively by exact bodySHA and must be checked. Do NOT claim300s CP admissionlease is Node-enforced use-key compromise bound: current actual bound is delegation/release/approval expiry plus acknowledged gate invalidation. Keep this Info explicit; no invented instantrevocation/shorterdelegation guarantee. State matrix CAS stage P+1 vs separately required final P+2; never call overlap phase final.
